testcase.name: milliseconds are truncated to centiseconds rather than rounded up past a second
word timings are dropped and the line's own text is kept whole
stamps are ascii digits regardless of the default locale
an instrumental gap is written as a bare stamp
lines are sorted by their stamp, whatever order they arrive in
an answering vocal is written back onto the end of its lead
what it writes, the parser reads back unchanged
a stamp past ninety-nine minutes overflows to three digits rather than wrapping
each line is stamped as mm colon ss dot centiseconds
no lines is empty text rather than a blank stamp
